basic_details.job_title: RCB Project Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Regional Centre for Biotechnology (RCB), Faridabad, is filling one Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post on the project "Mechanisms and Clinical Implications of Phenotypic Switching in Candida auris: Toward Targeted Antifungal Interventions". The fellowship is Rs.56,000/- + 30% HRA per month, and the initial tenure is one year. The essential qualification is a First Class Postgraduate degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Bioinformatics or a related discipline, with at least four years of research experience. content_sections.heading: About RCB
content_sections.text: The Regional Centre for Biotechnology is located at 3rd Milestone, Faridabad-Gurgaon Expressway, NCR Biotech Science Cluster, Faridabad, Faridabad - 121001, (Haryana). The notice gives its telephone number as 0129-2848800. The post sits in a research project led by Dr. Anil Thakur, Associate Professor, who is the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces one position. No category-wise break-up is printed.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints the following qualification for the post. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: First Class Postgraduate degree, including an integrated postgraduate degree, in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Bioinformatics, or a related discipline, with at least four years of research experience.
rows.desirable: Prior research experience specifically working with Candida species and a minimum of two research publications in relevant fields.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is Rs.56,000/- + 30% HRA per month. The engagement is initially for one year. It may be extended based on annual evaluation, till the duration of the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RCB Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical)
content_sections.text: Apply online through the application link in the notice by 25 November 2026, 05:00 PM. Upload copies of the M.Sc. Degree Certificate and the Certificate of Experience. For any query, contact the Principal Investigator by email at [email protected] . M.Sc. Degree Certificate Certificate of Experience

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email by 26 November 2026 to appear in the online interview. The interview will be held on 27 November 2026 from 10:30 AM onwards. The notice does not describe the shortlisting criteria or the interview format.
